data.text: I’m in. I commit to 15 tons this month, with the full $15,000 paid directly to the clinic, and no more than 6 tons next month under our shared recovery agreement. With Luke catching zero, that completes the $60,000 pledge. Let’s record everyone’s catches and donation receipts afterward. We return to 10 tons each only once the lake is back at 100 tons—our neighbors need care today and a healthy lake for the years ahead.
